`(int)SStack_448.distance_max` numerically converts float field `SStack_448.distance_max` to an integer, but this function's `.asm` contains no `FIST`/`FISTP` — the binary never performs a float-to-int conversion here, so the cast is fabricated. Ghidra lost the real integer (usually a local or global it dropped) and reached for a float field sharing the stack slot. See §32 — recover the true value from the asm; do not keep the cast.
